ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity (off-white/cream) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous off-white region spanning the majority of both lobes. Distinct black perimeter banding along the trailing edges and terminal tips. A single, high-contrast dark elliptical blob is located in the mid-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 50 to 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge boundary; serrations appear more pronounced and irregular on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve that sweeps upward and outward to sharply pointed distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular serration and potential minor notch-like losses along the trailing edge; isolated dark focal spot on the left interior lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive singular dark circular 'eye' mark located on the white field of the left lobe.
